test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The term ‘Dribble’ is generally associated with______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term '**dribble**' is used in **Basketball**.
 
• In basketball, dribbling is **bouncing the ball on the floor continuously with one hand at a time**.
 
• It is the **only legal way that a player may maintain possession of the ball **while walking or running.
 
• The dribble allows for much faster advancement and thus more opportunities for scoring.
 
• It also provides an opportunity for a crafty player on the opposing team to "steal" the ball in mid-bounce.
 
• **Dribbling should be done with finger pads and the fingers **should be relaxed and spread.
 
• The wrist should be pushing the basketball, and the forearm should be moving up and down.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basketball is a team sport in which there are two teams of five players each**.
 
• Players advance the ball by bouncing it while walking or running (dribbling) or by passing it to a teammate.
 
• On offense, players may use a variety of shots – **the layup, the jump shot, or a dunk; on defense.**
 
• They may steal the ball from a **dribbler, intercept passes, or block shots; either offense or defense may collect a rebound.**
 
• It is a violation to lift or drag one's pivot foot without dribbling the ball, to carry it, or to hold the ball with both hands and then resume dribbling.
